biography.plain_text: Jeffrey Fiorentino is an American entrepreneur who co-founded Kipu Health, the behavioural healthcare software company, and served as its chief executive. He studied entrepreneurship at the University of Miami, earned a master's degree in accounting and worked at Grant Thornton. He now leads The Fiorentino Family Office, which participates in commercial property investment.

long_biography.plain_text:
Software entrepreneur Jeffrey Fiorentino worked with Kipu's developers from the company's inception, testing its electronic records system inside a detoxification facility. Clinicians and administrative staff helped shape the product around their daily work. Ruby on Rails enabled rapid early development, although recruiting enough developers later became a constraint.

Customer support remained part of his operating approach. Kipu employed its own US-based support staff around the clock, recognising that treatment centres worked beyond conventional office hours. New recruits learned the industry's terminology and rules before studying the software. Clients received continuing training, customisation and upgrades without separate charges.
